messages:
maya-cs: Heads-up — AlpineTech dedicated pool bring-up slated for Thu 09:00 PT. Need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short load-test runbook. Who can take ownership of each piece?

sam-ops: I can take autoscale + runbook. Quick clarifying Q: do they want burst headroom beyond committed quota or strict cap? cc @david-pm

david-pm: They asked for a 20% burst window for short spikes (<=5m). Otherwise enforce cap at 250 RPS per pool. Also flag: renewal risk if app-level error_rate > 10% over 24h.

liam-sre: For safety, propose scale-up when GPU_util >= 70% for 60s, scale-down at <= 25% for 5m. Use step_scaling + cooldown 60s. Keeps churn low. Thoughts?

nora-ml: Model runtime notes: each replica holds ~6GB KV cache. At avg prompt len ~60 tokens and payloads per request typical, baseline math says 4 replicas to meet 250 RPS with <50ms queuing. If we expect bursts, set min_replicas=4.

sam-ops: Draft autoscale policy ready — dropping YAML so docs/ops can copy: 

```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 12
  metrics:
    - name: gpu_util
      threshold_up: 70
      threshold_down: 25
      up_duration_seconds: 60
      down_duration_seconds: 300
  step_size: 2
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  burst_headroom_percent: 20  # allows short bursts <=5m
```

maya-cs: perfect — can you add that to the onboarding doc and ping the customer-facing eng at T-48h? I'll confirm their traffic window.

sam-ops: will do. Also proposing a traffic-shift plan: start canary at 5% for 30m, 20% for 1h, then 100% with rollback guardrails.

liam-sre: For canary/watchlist, we'll monitor 4 signals: 99p latency, 5m error_rate, GPU_util, and request_queue_ms. Immediate rollback trigger: error_rate > 5% sustained 5m OR 99p latency increase > 2x baseline.

nora-ml: Adding a model quality check after canary: run 1k sample prompts through the canary model vs baseline and diff on BLEU-ish metric / embed-similarity. If similarity drops > 5%, hold.

sam-ops: Load test plan (short): 
- owner: sam-ops
- tool: k6 (script + ramp)
- pattern: 10m ramp to 200 RPS, 15m steady (200 RPS), 5m burst to 300 RPS, 10m cool-down
- checks: p95 < 500ms, error_rate < 2% during steady

k6 command: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m alpine_k6_script.js`

maya-cs: schedule confirmation: customer prefers Wed 16:00 PT for a warmup run, Thurs 09:00 PT for go-live. Can we get warmup load test Wed?

sam-ops: yes — I’ll schedule Wed 16:00. Will post test report + Prometheus snapshots.

liam-sre: small note — allocate a shadow slot for fallback: route 0% traffic initially but keep a fallback pool with pinned older model/quantization to switch if quality/regressions hit.

david-pm: documented renewal signal: if we run into repeated capacity misses during the 72h post-activation window, set renewal_engage = true and pingsales. Keep logs for the QBR.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: alpinetech-canary-2024-03-14T16:00Z (will post status updates).

maya-cs: awesome. Action items: 
- sam-ops: post YAML into onboarding doc + run Wed warmup + upload k6 script (owner)
- liam-sre: create canary watchlist, rollback playbook (owner)
- nora-ml: prepare 1k prompt quality suite and run post-canary
- david-pm: track renewal signal thresholds and coordinate sales notify rules

Please drop quick thumbs when you have these owned. :thumbsup:

sam-ops: owned. :white_check_mark:

liam-sre: owned.

nora-ml: owned, will upload test set by EOD tomorrow.

david-pm: will draft renewal notify flow.

maya-cs: thanks team — I'll update customer and share runbook link once sam posts it.
